title: Venezuelan Hash and Collard Greens
description: A hearty Mexican-inspired dish featuring crispy Venezuelan hash and sautéed collard greens.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chopped collard greens and cook until wilted, about 5 minutes.
Add the Venezuelan hash to the skillet and stir to combine with the collard greens.
Season with cumin, salt, and black pepper to taste.
Warm the flour tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the dish by placing a portion of the hash and collard greens onto a tortilla and serving.
